summary.intent: Execute all 7 plans for Phase 21 (BYO IPFS Node Support) using GSD wave-based parallel execution, perform UAT of the full BYO migration pipeline, then create gap closure plans for issues found during testing.
summary.outcome: All 7 plans executed across 4 waves with multiple bugs found and fixed during Playwright UAT; core migration pipeline verified (44/44 CIDs migrated to external Kubo node); 4 gap closure plans (21-08 through 21-11) created covering dual-pin wiring, TEE-routed connection test, PinataProvider, and benchmark baselines.

repo: TEE worker does not auto-load .env files — tsx/node doesn't pick them up; env vars must be passed inline at process start
BullMQ jobs persist in Redis and are picked up by new API instances on restart, causing stale failed jobs to be re-processed before the new instance is fully ready
The auth store is memory-only (no localStorage persistence), so Playwright tests cannot inject auth state and must go through the full UI login flow
The test-login API endpoint creates a duplicate auth method conflict if the same email is subsequently used via email+OTP flow (unique constraint on UQ_auth_methods_type_hash)
Pin migration is copy-only by design — no source unpin step after CID integrity verification
Pinata deprecated their standard PSA endpoint (/psa returns 404); their current API is /v3/files (proprietary)
CID version differences (v0 vs v1) can cause ~1/44 CID failures in cross-node migrations
Kubo nodes default to binding API on 127.0.0.1:5001, not 0.0.0.0 — must reconfigure for external access
SaaS IPFS providers (Pinata, Filebase) use non-standard auth and endpoints that deviate from both Kubo RPC and PSA specs
DHCP can reassign the host IP on the VM bridge network after Docker stack restarts — .env files with hardcoded IPs need updating

code.finding: Used TEE_AUTH_SECRET env var but TeeService and the rest of the codebase use TEE_WORKER_SECRET — caused 'TEE_WORKER_URL or TEE_AUTH_SECRET not configured' error blocking all migrations

ECIES-encrypted configs are sent as hex strings from StorageTab (bytesToHex) but TEE worker decoded them as base64 (Buffer.from(encryptedBase64, 'base64')), causing 'bad point: got length 65' crypto error
SSRF validation blocked 192.168.* ranges, preventing local Kubo node access in dev. Fixed with simulator-mode bypass. Also missing 'cipherbox' as a valid protocol type in parseProviderConfig

Migration trigger condition required savedConfig to be non-null AND usedBytes > 0 AND mode/endpoint changed. First-time users switching from default 'cipherbox' have null savedConfig, so migration never fired. Fixed by treating null savedConfig as implicit 'cipherbox' mode.

Non-200 responses (including 401/403/422) were all treated as 'endpoint not found' and fell through to 'could not detect protocol'. Fixed to surface auth failures distinctly so users get actionable error messages.

Dual-pin upload not wired: DualPinProvider exists in SDK and PinningConfig is saved, but the web app's upload flow invokes API relay only — SDK's pinWithMode() is never called during uploads, so secondary pin never fires

workflow: GSD wave-based execution keeps orchestrator context at ~10-15% by passing only file paths to subagents which load their own 200k context fresh
Playwright MCP enables full browser automation including file uploads, form fills, and screenshot capture for UI verification checkpoints
classifyHandoffIfNeeded runtime error in Claude Code is a known bug that fires after all tool calls complete — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to determine real success/failure
Hot-reload (Nest watch mode) does not release port bindings; old API process must be killed explicitly before a new one can bind the same port
GSD continuation agent pattern (spawn fresh agent with explicit state rather than resuming) is more reliable than resume for checkpoint handling
Running 'test-login' API before email OTP for the same email address creates a duplicate key conflict — use different emails for each auth path in testing

friction: Docker stack DHCP IP change from 192.168.133.114 to .12 after restart — required updating 5 entries in apps/api/.env before API would start
QEMU VM network topology confusion: VM is guest of the machine running Docker, so 'host' means the gateway (.2), not the services host (.12)
TEE worker silently ignoring .env file — required passing all env vars inline at process start; took multiple restart attempts to diagnose
API hot-reload (NestJS watch) picked up file changes but old process retained port 3000, causing EADDRINUSE on reload — fix never took effect until manual kill
BullMQ stale jobs from failed API instances were re-processed by new instances before fixes were applied, making it hard to tell if fixes worked
Pinata PSA endpoint deprecated with no warning — /psa returns 404, users trying to configure Pinata get a misleading 'could not detect protocol' error
CORS blocks browser-side connection testing of all SaaS IPFS providers (Pinata, Filebase) — entire connection test flow is broken for the most common provider types
OTP retrieval pattern took several unnecessary roundabouts — assistant searched filesystem for task output files when the API dev server output was directly accessible via background task ID
Duplicate migration UI component showing old failed state after successful re-migration — component doesn't re-fetch on mount if a 'completed' migration exists in DB
open_items: 21-08: Wire SDK BYO config into web app upload flow so DualPinProvider.pin() is called during file upload (secondary pin currently never fires)
21-08: Add source unpin step to TEE migration worker after CID integrity verification succeeds
21-09: Move connection test from browser-side to TEE-routed endpoint (POST /tee/test-connection with ECIES-wrapped config) to eliminate CORS blocking and preserve zero-knowledge
21-10: Implement PinataProvider using Pinata's current /v3/files API (PSA /psa endpoint deprecated)
21-11: Run BYO performance benchmarks against real external IPFS provider and capture baselines in .planning/baselines/21-byo-baselines.md
TEE worker SSRF bypass for simulator mode needs to be replaced with proper allow-list for dev environments before production deployment
Reverse migration (external → cipherbox) had 1/45 CID failure — investigate CID version mismatch (v0 vs v1) handling in migration worker
MigrationProgress component doesn't clear/reset when a new successful migration completes after a failed one — shows stale failed state
